comment:
* Base class declaring the specific methods and members for SmsMessage.

variables.name: NAME_ADDR_EMAIL_PATTERN
variables.comment: Copied from Telephony.Mms.NAME_ADDR_EMAIL_PATTERN

variables.name: mScAddress
variables.comment: {@hide} The address of the SMSC. May be null

variables.name: mOriginatingAddress
variables.comment: {@hide} The address of the sender

variables.name: mRecipientAddress
variables.comment: {@hide} The address of the receiver

variables.name: mMessageBody
variables.comment: {@hide} The message body as a string. May be null if the message isn't text

variables.name: mPseudoSubject
variables.comment: {@hide}

variables.name: mEmailFrom
variables.comment: {@hide} Non-null if this is an email gateway message

variables.name: mEmailBody
variables.comment: {@hide} Non-null if this is an email gateway message

variables.name: mIsEmail
variables.comment: {@hide}

variables.name: mScTimeMillis
variables.comment: {@hide} Time when SC (service centre) received the message

variables.name: mPdu
variables.comment: {@hide} The raw PDU of the message

variables.name: mUserData
variables.comment: {@hide} The raw bytes for the user data section of the message

variables.name: mUserDataHeader
variables.comment: {@hide}

variables.name: mIsMwi
variables.comment: {@hide}

variables.name: mMwiSense
variables.comment: {@hide}

variables.name: mMwiDontStore
variables.comment: {@hide}

variables.name: mReceivedEncodingType
variables.comment:
* The encoding type of a received SMS message, which is specified using ENCODING_*
     * GSM: defined in android.telephony.SmsConstants
     * CDMA: defined in android.telephony.cdma.UserData
     *
     * @hide

variables.name: mStatusOnIcc
variables.comment: * Indicates status for messages stored on the ICC.

variables.name: mIndexOnIcc
variables.comment: * Record index of message in the EF.

variables.name: mMessageRef
variables.comment: TP-Message-Reference - Message Reference of sent message. @hide

methods.name: public String getServiceCenterAddress()
methods.comment:
* Returns the address of the SMS service center that relayed this message
     * or null if there is none.

methods.name: public String getOriginatingAddress()
methods.comment:
* Returns the originating address (sender) of this SMS message in String
     * form or null if unavailable

methods.name: public String getDisplayOriginatingAddress()
methods.comment:
* Returns the originating address, or email from address if this message
     * was from an email gateway. Returns null if originating address
     * unavailable.

methods.name: public String getMessageBody()
methods.comment:
* Returns the message body as a String, if it exists and is text based.
     * @return message body is there is one, otherwise null

methods.name: public abstract SmsConstants.MessageClass getMessageClass()
methods.comment: * Returns the class of this message.

methods.name: public String getDisplayMessageBody()
methods.comment:
* Returns the message body, or email message body if this message was from
     * an email gateway. Returns null if message body unavailable.

methods.name: public String getPseudoSubject()
methods.comment:
* Unofficial convention of a subject line enclosed in parens empty string
     * if not present

methods.name: public long getTimestampMillis()
methods.comment: * Returns the service centre timestamp in currentTimeMillis() format

methods.name: public boolean isEmail()
methods.comment:
* Returns true if message is an email.
     *
     * @return true if this message came through an email gateway and email
     *         sender / subject / parsed body are available

methods.name: public String getEmailBody()
methods.comment:
* @return if isEmail() is true, body of the email sent through the gateway.
     *         null otherwise

methods.name: public String getEmailFrom()
methods.comment:
* @return if isEmail() is true, email from address of email sent through
     *         the gateway. null otherwise

methods.name: public abstract int getProtocolIdentifier()
methods.comment: * Get protocol identifier.

methods.name: public abstract boolean isReplace()
methods.comment:
* See TS 23.040 9.2.3.9 returns true if this is a "replace short message"
     * SMS

methods.name: public abstract boolean isCphsMwiMessage()
methods.comment:
* Returns true for CPHS MWI toggle message.
     *
     * @return true if this is a CPHS MWI toggle message See CPHS 4.2 section
     *         B.4.2

methods.name: public abstract boolean isMWIClearMessage()
methods.comment:
* returns true if this message is a CPHS voicemail / message waiting
     * indicator (MWI) clear message

methods.name: public abstract boolean isMWISetMessage()
methods.comment:
* returns true if this message is a CPHS voicemail / message waiting
     * indicator (MWI) set message

methods.name: public abstract boolean isMwiDontStore()
methods.comment:
* returns true if this message is a "Message Waiting Indication Group:
     * Discard Message" notification and should not be stored.

methods.name: public byte[] getUserData()
methods.comment:
* returns the user data section minus the user data header if one was
     * present.

methods.name: public SmsHeader getUserDataHeader()
public byte[] getPdu()
methods.comment: * Returns the raw PDU for the message.

methods.name: public abstract int getStatus()
methods.comment:
* For an SMS-STATUS-REPORT message, this returns the status field from
     * the status report.  This field indicates the status of a previously
     * submitted SMS, if requested.  See TS 23.040, 9.2.3.15 TP-Status for a
     * description of values.
     *
     * @return 0 indicates the previously sent message was received.
     *         See TS 23.040, 9.9.2.3.15 for a description of other possible
     *         values.

methods.name: public abstract boolean isStatusReportMessage()
methods.comment: * Return true iff the message is a SMS-STATUS-REPORT message.

methods.name: public abstract boolean isReplyPathPresent()
methods.comment: * Returns true iff the TP-Reply-Path bit is set in * this message.

methods.name: public int getStatusOnIcc()
methods.comment:
* Returns the status of the message on the ICC (read, unread, sent, unsent).
     *
     * @return the status of the message on the ICC.  These are:
     *         SmsManager.STATUS_ON_ICC_FREE
     *         SmsManager.STATUS_ON_ICC_READ
     *         SmsManager.STATUS_ON_ICC_UNREAD
     *         SmsManager.STATUS_ON_ICC_SEND
     *         SmsManager.STATUS_ON_ICC_UNSENT

methods.name: public int getIndexOnIcc()
methods.comment:
* Returns the record index of the message on the ICC (1-based index).
     * @return the record index of the message on the ICC, or -1 if this
     *         SmsMessage was not created from a ICC SMS EF record.

methods.name: public static boolean isEmailAddress(String messageHeader)
methods.comment:
* Returns true if the message header string indicates that the message is from a email address.
     *
     * @param messageHeader message header
     * @return {@code true} if it's a message from an email address, {@code false} otherwise.

methods.name: protected void extractEmailAddressFromMessageBody()
methods.comment:
* Try to parse this message as an email gateway message
     * There are two ways specified in TS 23.040 Section 3.8 :
     *  - SMS message "may have its TP-PID set for Internet electronic mail - MT
     * SMS format: [<from-address><space>]<message> - "Depending on the
     * nature of the gateway, the destination/origination address is either
     * derived from the content of the SMS TP-OA or TP-DA field, or the
     * TP-OA/TP-DA field contains a generic gateway address and the to/from
     * address is added at the beginning as shown above." (which is supported here)
     * - Multiple addresses separated by commas, no spaces, Subject field delimited
     * by '()' or '##' and '#' Section 9.2.3.24.11 (which are NOT supported here)

methods.name: public static int findNextUnicodePosition(int currentPosition, int byteLimit, CharSequence msgBody)
methods.comment:
* Find the next position to start a new fragment of a multipart SMS.
     *
     * @param currentPosition current start position of the fragment
     * @param byteLimit maximum number of bytes in the fragment
     * @param msgBody text of the SMS in UTF-16 encoding
     * @return the position to start the next fragment

methods.name: public static TextEncodingDetails calcUnicodeEncodingDetails(CharSequence msgBody)
methods.comment: * Calculate the TextEncodingDetails of a message encoded in Unicode.

methods.name: public String getRecipientAddress()
